title: Yakushima vs Mount Aso: Which Should You Visit?
verdict: Yakushima for the most transcendent nature experience in Japan. Mount Aso for dramatic volcanic scenery without the logistics overhead.

categories.name: Nature & Hiking
categories.summary: Jōmon Sugi (7,200yr cedar), Princess Mononoke forest vs active volcano caldera.

categories.name: Cost
categories.summary: Aso costs roughly half as much — no boat/flight required.

categories.name: Logistics
categories.summary: Aso is a day-trip-able train ride; Yakushima needs ferry + rental car + multi-night planning.

faq.question: Is Yakushima or Mount Aso better for first-time Kyushu visitors?
faq.answer: Mount Aso — easier logistics, no island transport required.

faq.question: How many days do you need for Yakushima?
faq.answer: 3 nights minimum. Day trips are strongly discouraged.
